```
def d22278a0(I):

    ys, xs = np.where(green)
    y0,y1,x0,x1 = ys.min(), ys.max(), xs.min(), xs.max()
    O = I.copy()
    for y,x in zip(*np.where((I!=0)&(I!=8))):
        c = I[y,x]
        if y < y0: O[y0,x] = c
        elif y > y1: O[y1,x] = c
        elif x < x0: O[y,x0] = c
        elif x > x1: O[y,x1] = c
    return O
```
